subject: RE: BlueLantern PO line-item mismatch & provisional spend cap
messages:
From: Alex Hwang <alex.hwang@bluelantern.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: PO issuance mismatch for onboarding batch

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from our AP team: we received invoice INV-2241 referencing a Redwood PO #, but the PO number in your system (we see 9147) doesn't map to the line items we submitted. Several SKUs in the BL_PO_batch_01.csv (attached) are either missing PO line references or are split across two different PO numbers.

We also ran into a spend cap: our onboarding spend was blocked at $12,000 while our expected onboarding allowance was $25,000 per the intake form the account team sent. This is holding up procurement sign-off and our vendor onboarding.

Can you confirm which PO numbers will be issued for this batch and whether a provisional spend-cap increase is possible until the full vendor verification completes? If helpful, cc'ing purchasing@bluelantern.com.

Attachments: BL_PO_batch_01.csv (attachment)

Thanks,
Alex Hwang
Head of Procurement
BlueLantern Logistics
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Hwang <alex.hwang@bluelantern.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO issuance mismatch for onboarding batch

Alex —

Thanks for the detail and the CSV, I can see the mismatch on a quick pass. Sorry for the friction here. I'm looping in Monica (procurement) and Connor (ledger/ops) to pull the PO issuance logs and map the incoming SKUs back to the correct PO range.

Two quick asks while we investigate:
- Can you confirm BlueLantern's vendor onboarding form was submitted under tax id 12-3456789?
- Would you be comfortable with a provisional spend-cap increase to $30,000 for 14 days while we complete verification? That will let you finish the initial onboarding shipments.

We'll aim to have a proposed corrected PO assignment and a compact reconciliation (CSV) by EOD Tue.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Hwang <alex.hwang@bluelantern.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: RE: PO issuance mismatch for onboarding batch

Alex / Tessa —

Quick update from procurement ops: we reviewed the BL_PO_batch_01.csv and found two root causes: a) vendor submitted two slightly different SKU codes for the same physical item which triggered duplicate tentative PO allocation, and b) the onboarding form did not propagate the correct spend bracket into our provisioning flow (hence the $12k cap).

Plan:
- We'll generate a consolidated PO range (9147-9150) and mark 9149 as the canonical PO for the duplicate SKU set.
- I'll approve a temporary spend-cap bump to $30,000 (14-day window) so BlueLantern can complete their initial shipments.
- Connor will push a corrected line-item mapping CSV back to your AP team before EOD Wed.

Attachments: ponum-discrepancy-snapshot.png (screenshots of mapping issue)
Reference: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/78910
DocuSign (pending signature for updated T&Cs): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC123

Notes / asks from BlueLantern: please confirm the vendor tax id you used and a primary contact for invoices so we can update the vendor profile.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Hwang <alex.hwang@bluelantern.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: PO issuance mismatch for onboarding batch

All —

I pulled the ledger and here's the concise mapping we propose (summary inline, full CSV attached in internal system):

- BL SKU BL-6001 -> PO 9147, Line 1, qty 100, unit price $45 (was previously split to PO 9120 Line 3)
- BL SKU BL-6001-ALT -> canonicalized to BL-6001 and consolidated under PO 9147 Line 2 (total qty combined 120)
- BL SKU BL-6022 -> PO 9148 Line 1 (no change)

Action items:
1) Monica to approve the PO range 9147-9150 and sign off on temporary spend cap increase.
2) BlueLantern to confirm BL-6001/BL-6001-ALT are the same item for AP reconciliation.
3) I will schedule a purge and reissue of affected PO numbers in the provisioning queue; this will create a short audit event but maintain traceability. Expect corrected CSV to be pushed to your AP inbox by 17:00 PST today.

On Tue, Jan 12, 2026 at 08:14 Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex / Tessa —
> 
> Quick update from procurement ops: we reviewed the BL_PO_batch_01.csv and found two root causes: a) vendor submitted two slightly different SKU codes for the same physical item which triggered duplicate tentative PO allocation, and b) the onboarding form did not propagate the correct spend bracket into our provisioning flow (hence the $12k cap).

Attachments referenced internally: corrected_lineitem_map_9147.csv (internal)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Finance Systems | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Hwang <alex.hwang@bluelantern.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueLantern PO line-item mismatch & provisional spend cap

Thanks everyone — confirming BlueLantern submitted onboarding under tax id 12-3456789 and BL-6001 and BL-6001-ALT are indeed the same SKU (we see a legacy suffix in the older ERP export).

We agree to the PO range 9147-9150 and the provisional spend cap of $30,000 for 14 days. We also signed the updated T&Cs via DocuSign (ID ABC123); attached is the signed PDF for your records (BL_signed_docusign_9147.pdf).

Please let us know once the corrected PO CSV is posted so we can close the AP ticket on our side. Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Alex Hwang
BlueLantern Logistics
